acceptanceNotes: Accepted by the user-selected isolated AI panel on 2026-10-22; this is AI review, not human or external-expert review.

Three reviewers independently assessed the complete 24-question packet, then reconsidered anonymized peer rationales; all unanimously passed answer support, citation accuracy, and abstention handling on all 24 questions.

A prior human review of a different run remains recorded as historical context (17/24 supported, 23/24 citations accurate, 18/24 abstention decisions appropriate); it is not represented as the acceptance decision for this run.

The acceptance pins the hybrid run, question packet, source registry, generation, evidence snapshot, and embedding model. Expected-source hits are source-level only and do not establish passage relevance or answer correctness.
